Interface IRemovedDerivedContainerInfo

      • restore

        @PublishedMethod
void restore()
        Recreates the specified container using its derived value. Mandatory child objects will be created too and pre-configuration, recommended config and default values will be applied. If this container is not a removed derived sub-container, this operation silently does nothing.

        The behavior in variant projects depends on the variant context which is active when this method is being called:

        • In a single variant view, this method checks the following conditions:
          • Does the parent already have a child object with the specified shortname in another variant?
          • Does the derived counterpart (the InitialEcuC container) which is visible in the current view have less visibility as the specified parent?

          If one of these conditions is true, the restored container must have a variation point to avoid duplicate shortnames (first condition) or more visibility as the original derived container (second condition). The restore is therefore being executed using the variant specific mode. So the resulting container instance is visible in the current view only.

          If both conditions are false, the container instance is being restored without a variation point resulting in an ActiveEcuC container with the same visibility as the parent. If the caller strictly requires variant specific behavior, it must switch to the variant specific change mode in advance.

        • In the unfiltered view, this method checks the following conditions:
          • Does the parent already have a child object with the specified shortname?
          • Does one of derived counterparts (there are probably several variant InitialEcuC containers) have less visibility as the specified parent?

          If one of these conditions is true, the restore is being executed in all variants, the parent is visible in, using the variant specific mode as described above.

          If both conditions are false, the container is being restored once for all variants, the parent is visible in. In either case, the result will be that the restored container is available in all variants, the parent is visible in and were a derived container is available in the InitialEcuC.
